title: OpenWoud: Vendor-Unlocked Scalable Adaptive Random Forest Accelerator
abstract: Online Machine Learning (ML) enables real-time decision-making on evolving data streams. These dynamic models learn continuously to adapt to new concepts, as previous ones become invalid, but their performance is often limited by throughput. The Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) is a state-of-the-art model for this setting, which naturally exposes parallelism and is therefore well-suited for hardware acceleration. However, prior Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based accelerators are vendor-locked and rely on resource-hungry Floating-Point (FP) arithmetics, limiting their scalability and portability. We present OpenWoud, a vendor-unlocked ARF framework for FPGAs. Our design replaces FP operators with a flexible FiXed-Point (FxP) arithmetic library and introduces fully transparent, manually scheduled dataflows for training and drift detection. This enables fine-grained time/area trade-offs and predictable behavior across platforms. A comprehensive evaluation on both synthetic and real datasets shows that OpenWoud maintains or increases accuracy (up to +12.89%), compared to a prior FPGA accelerator, while reducing the resource utilization by half. Competitive performance is observed compared to GPU (0.5 - 1.5x speed-up) and an FPGA baseline (0.2 - 0.5x), despite the latter being based on idealized simulation. Crucially, OpenWoud sustains true sample-by-sample inference, unlike GPUs that require batch insertion.
abstract_cn: 在线机器学习（ML）能够对不断变化的数据流进行实时决策。这类动态模型持续学习，在原有概念失效时适应新概念，但其性能往往受吞吐量限制。自适应随机森林（ARF）是这一场景下的先进模型，具有天然的并行性，因而适合硬件加速。然而，已有的现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）加速器受厂商锁定，并依赖资源开销较大的浮点（FP）运算，限制了可扩展性和可移植性。我们提出 OpenWoud，这是一个不受厂商锁定的 FPGA ARF 框架。该设计用灵活的定点（FxP）算术库替代浮点运算单元，并为训练和漂移检测引入完全透明、由人工调度的数据流，从而支持细粒度的时间与面积权衡，并使跨平台运行行为可预测。对合成数据集和真实数据集的全面评估表明，与此前的 FPGA 加速器相比，OpenWoud 在将资源用量减半的同时，保持或提高了准确率，最高提升 12.89%。与 GPU 和 FPGA 基线相比，OpenWoud 表现出有竞争力的性能，速度分别为两者的 0.5–1.5 倍和 0.2–0.5 倍，其中 FPGA 基线基于理想化仿真。重要的是，OpenWoud 能够持续进行真正的逐样本推理，而 GPU 需要批量插入样本。
takeaway: 在合成和真实数据集上，OpenWoud 相比此前的 FPGA 加速器将资源用量减半，同时保持或提高准确率，最高提升 12.89%。它支持持续逐样本推理，速度为需要批量插入样本的 GPU 的 0.5–1.5 倍，以及基于理想化仿真的 FPGA 基线的 0.2–0.5 倍。
innovation: 1. 为 FPGA 构建不受厂商锁定的 ARF 框架，使用灵活的定点算术库替代浮点运算单元；2. 为训练和漂移检测设计完全透明、由人工调度的数据流，支持细粒度的时间与面积权衡，并使跨平台运行行为可预测。

title: Power Side-Channel Evaluation using Multi-FPGA Systems
abstract: Complex out-of-order processors are difficult to evaluate for power side-channel leakage before tapeout. A single FPGA often lacks sufficient capacity, whereas conventional CAD-based analysis is too slow to support the large numbers of traces required by practical attacks. Multi-FPGA emulation provides greater capacity, but existing partitioning schemes are not security-aware and thus results in poor attack performance. This work presents Scissors, a security-aware multi-FPGA partitioning approach for pre-silicon power side-channel evaluation of complex out-of-order processors. Scissors uses side-channel vulnerability factor (SVF) analysis to identify signals correlated with the secret key. It then keeps strongly key-correlated signals confined to one FPGA partition (measured) while moving rest of the signals to the other FPGAs (support), improving the observability of the side-channel information. We evaluate Scissors through RTL simulations and physical measurements on a two-U200 FPGA testbed, using frequency-domain CPA with a Hamming-weight leakage model. RTL ablation shows that only 68-71 high-SVF signals dominate key recovery process. For a single-core processor (SingleBOOM), Scissors recovers the key with 12,000 traces, compared with 49,000 for the unpartitioned design and 43,000 for TritonPart, while improving correct-key correlation by $2.83\times$. For a quad-core processor (QuadBOOM), which exceeds the capacity of the CW340 single-FPGA platform, Scissors reduces the required traces from 111,000 to 66,000 and improves correlation by $1.48\times$ over TritonPart. Scissors also reduces QuadBOOM RTL-to-bitstream generation from 61 h 39 min to 6 h 40 min, a $9.25\times$ speedup. These results show that security-aware partitioning improves leakage observability and attack performance while substantially reducing implementation time for complex processors against the baseline method.
abstract_cn: 复杂乱序处理器的功耗侧信道泄漏难以在流片前评估。单块 FPGA 往往容量不足，而传统的基于计算机辅助设计（CAD）的分析速度过慢，难以支持实际攻击所需的大量功耗迹线。多 FPGA 仿真能够提供更大的容量，但现有划分方案未考虑安全性，导致攻击效果较差。本文提出 Scissors，一种面向复杂乱序处理器的流片前功耗侧信道评估、考虑安全性的多 FPGA 划分方法。Scissors 使用侧信道脆弱性因子（SVF）分析识别与密钥相关的信号，将与密钥高度相关的信号集中到一块用于测量的 FPGA 上，并将其余信号移至其他辅助 FPGA，以提高侧信道信息的可观测性。我们通过 RTL 仿真和由 2 块 U200 FPGA 构成的测试平台上的实测来评估 Scissors，采用基于汉明重量泄漏模型的频域相关功耗分析（CPA）。RTL 消融实验表明，仅 68–71 个高 SVF 信号就在密钥恢复过程中起主导作用。对于单核处理器 SingleBOOM，Scissors 用 12,000 条迹线即可恢复密钥，而未划分设计和 TritonPart 分别需要 49,000 条和 43,000 条，正确密钥对应的相关性提高至 2.83 倍。对于容量超出 CW340 单 FPGA 平台的四核处理器 QuadBOOM，与 TritonPart 相比，Scissors 将所需迹线从 111,000 条降至 66,000 条，并将相关性提高至 1.48 倍。Scissors 还将 QuadBOOM 从 RTL 到生成比特流的时间从 61 小时 39 分钟缩短至 6 小时 40 分钟，实现 9.25 倍加速。结果表明，相比基线方法，考虑安全性的划分能够提高泄漏的可观测性和攻击效果，同时大幅缩短复杂处理器的实现时间。
takeaway: Scissors 将 SingleBOOM 恢复密钥所需的迹线数降至 12,000 条，未划分设计和 TritonPart 分别需要 49,000 条和 43,000 条。对超出 CW340 单 FPGA 容量的 QuadBOOM，Scissors 相比 TritonPart 将所需迹线从 111,000 条降至 66,000 条，将相关性提高至 1.48 倍，并将 RTL 到比特流的生成过程加速 9.25 倍。
innovation: 1. 提出用于复杂乱序处理器流片前功耗侧信道评估的多 FPGA 划分方法 Scissors，通过 SVF 分析识别密钥相关信号，将高度相关的信号集中在测量 FPGA 上，其余信号分配至辅助 FPGA，以提高泄漏可观测性。

title: CPU-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models for CPU Hardware Code Generation
abstract: Benchmarks such as VerilogEval have supported rapid advances in hardware description language (HDL) generation by large language models (LLMs). However, recent HDL-generation systems achieve pass rates above 90% on VerilogEval, leaving limited headroom for revealing further advances. To provide a challenging target for further progress on a practically important hardware-development task, we introduce CPU-Eval, a benchmark of 339 HDL-generation problems constructed from six CPUs. Drawn from practical CPU designs, including families fabricated in silicon, the problems span CPUs from small embedded cores to Linux-capable out-of-order cores and cover diverse CPU functions written in SystemVerilog, Chisel, and SpinalHDL. In each problem, an LLM performs the real CPU-development task of generating HDL. Across seven state-of-the-art LLMs, mean pass@1 is 45.14 percentage points lower on CPU-Eval than on VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL, exposing capability differences obscured by VerilogEval's high pass rates. CPU-Eval reveals that pass@1 is lower for submodules with more source-code lines, which motivates fine-grained modular design for LLM-aided hardware generation. We also show that pass@1 is lower for CPUs written in less widely used HDLs, motivating designers to verify that an LLM is sufficiently proficient at generating code in the HDL they use before deployment.
abstract_cn: VerilogEval 等基准推动了大型语言模型（LLM）生成硬件描述语言（HDL）代码的快速进展。然而，近期的 HDL 生成系统在 VerilogEval 上的通过率已超过 90%，使该基准能反映的后续提升空间有限。为了给这一具有实际意义的硬件开发任务提供更具挑战性的评测目标，我们提出 CPU-Eval，一个基于 6 款 CPU 构建、包含 339 道 HDL 生成题目的基准。这些题目取材于实际 CPU 设计，其中包括已制造为芯片的处理器系列。题目涵盖从小型嵌入式核心到能够运行 Linux 的乱序核心，并覆盖以 SystemVerilog、Chisel 和 SpinalHDL 编写的多种 CPU 功能。每道题都要求 LLM 执行真实 CPU 开发中的 HDL 代码生成任务。在 7 个先进 LLM 上，CPU-Eval 的平均 pass@1 比 VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL 低 45.14 个百分点，揭示了被 VerilogEval 高通过率掩盖的能力差异。CPU-Eval 的结果表明，源代码行数更多的子模块具有更低的 pass@1，这为 LLM 辅助硬件生成采用细粒度模块化设计提供了依据。我们还发现，使用较少见的 HDL 编写的 CPU 具有更低的 pass@1，这表明设计人员在部署前有必要验证 LLM 是否具备足够的目标 HDL 代码生成能力。
takeaway: 在 7 个先进 LLM 上，基于实际 CPU 设计的 CPU-Eval 平均 pass@1 比 VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL 低 45.14 个百分点。源代码行数更多的子模块以及用较少见的 HDL 编写的 CPU 对应的 pass@1 更低。
innovation: 1. 构建 CPU-Eval，从 6 款实际 CPU 设计中提取 339 道真实开发场景中的 HDL 生成题目，涵盖多种核心、CPU 功能及 SystemVerilog、Chisel 和 SpinalHDL。

title: Scaling Architectural Simulation to Giga Instructions Per Second
abstract: The cost of detailed architectural simulation constrains design-space exploration, while parallelization across simulated cores offers limited host concurrency for single-core and small multicore targets. We present GIPSim, an instruction-driven simulator that derives instruction timing from dependencies and resource constraints, reducing the overhead of updating pipeline state every simulated cycle. It applies synchronization-guided temporal decomposition to recorded execution, exposing host parallelism beyond the target core count. GIPSim replays the resulting segments in parallel and aggregates their durations through a dependency graph to estimate overall execution time, with replay contexts reconstructed using retained microarchitectural state, warmup, and synchronization-guided cache eviction. This accounts for synchronization waits without requiring host workers to follow target execution order. We evaluate GIPSim using QEMU traces of application and operating system execution on multi-core x86-64, AArch64, and RV64GC systems. GIPSim achieves an average single-node simulation throughput of 13.8 million instructions per second (MIPS) with one worker and 1{,}010 MIPS with 96 workers, peaking at 1{,}421 MIPS. The corresponding mean absolute percentage errors in execution cycles relative to gem5 are 7.52\% and 7.43\%, respectively.
abstract_cn: 细粒度体系结构仿真的开销限制了设计空间探索，而对于单核和小规模多核目标，按被仿真核心划分任务只能提供有限的宿主机并行度。我们提出 GIPSim，一种指令驱动的仿真器，根据依赖关系和资源约束推导指令时序，从而减少每个仿真周期更新流水线状态的开销。GIPSim 在同步事件的引导下对记录的执行过程进行时间分解，使宿主机并行度能够超越目标核心数。GIPSim 并行重放分解得到的各个片段，利用依赖图汇总各片段的执行时长以估计总执行时间，并利用保留的微体系结构状态、预热以及同步引导的缓存驱逐来重建重放上下文。这一方法可以计入同步等待时间，同时允许宿主机工作单元独立于目标系统的执行顺序运行。我们使用 QEMU 记录的多核 x86-64、AArch64 和 RV64GC 系统上的应用程序及操作系统执行迹线评估 GIPSim。在单节点上，使用 1 个工作单元时的平均仿真吞吐量为 13.8 百万条指令/秒（MIPS），使用 96 个工作单元时为 1,010 MIPS，峰值达到 1,421 MIPS。相对 gem5，两种配置下执行周期数的平均绝对百分比误差分别为 7.52% 和 7.43%。
takeaway: 在多核 x86-64、AArch64 和 RV64GC 系统的 QEMU 应用及操作系统执行迹线上，GIPSim 的单节点平均吞吐量从 1 个工作单元时的 13.8 MIPS 提高到 96 个工作单元时的 1,010 MIPS，峰值为 1,421 MIPS。相对 gem5，两种配置的执行周期数平均绝对百分比误差分别为 7.52% 和 7.43%。
innovation: 1. 采用指令驱动仿真，依据依赖关系和资源约束推导指令时序，降低逐周期更新流水线状态的开销；2. 利用同步信息对记录的执行过程进行时间分解，以发掘超越目标核心数的宿主机并行度；3. 并行重放片段并通过依赖图汇总时长以计入同步等待，同时利用保留的微体系结构状态、预热和同步引导的缓存驱逐重建重放上下文。

title: Trading BRAM for LUTs: Hybrid Bit-Level Weight Storage for FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an attractive paradigm for energy-efficient AI inference, while their deployment on reconfigurable hardware enables application-specific acceleration without sacrificing model reprogrammability. However, realizing this potential on FPGAs is often severely constrained by the immense on-chip memory needed to store synaptic weights. Existing compression techniques reduce this storage requirement at the cost of weight precision or accuracy. This work presents a hybrid bit-level weight-storage scheme that trades BRAM capacity for FPGA logic resources while preserving the original weights unmodified. Selected weight bits are implemented using Look-Up Tables (LUTs), while the remaining bits are stored in BRAM and jointly reconstructed during inference. We integrate this approach into a spatial dataflow SNN architecture and introduce a practical bit-mapping heuristic that efficiently partitions weight bits between BRAM and LUT-based logic without modifying the weights. Experimental evaluation demonstrates more than 26% reduction in BRAM utilization with a modest increase in LUT and register usage, resulting in significant overall power savings.
abstract_cn: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）为高能效 AI 推理提供了一种有吸引力的计算模式，将其部署在可重构硬件上则能够在保留模型可重编程性的同时实现面向应用的专用加速。然而，在 FPGA 上发挥这一潜力往往受到严重限制，因为存储突触权重需要大量片上存储。已有压缩技术以牺牲权重精度或准确率为代价降低存储需求。本文提出一种位级混合权重存储方案，以 FPGA 逻辑资源换取块 RAM（BRAM）容量，同时完整保留原始权重。该方案用查找表（LUT）实现选定的权重位，将其余位存入 BRAM，并在推理期间结合两部分重建权重。我们将该方案集成到空间数据流 SNN 架构中，并提出一种实用的位映射启发式算法，在保留原始权重的同时，高效地将权重位分配给 BRAM 和基于 LUT 的逻辑。实验评估表明，BRAM 用量降低超过 26%，LUT 和寄存器用量小幅增加，总体功耗显著下降。
takeaway: 在保留原始权重的条件下，位级混合存储方案将 FPGA 上 SNN 的 BRAM 用量降低超过 26%，代价是 LUT 和寄存器用量小幅增加，同时总体功耗显著下降。
innovation: 1. 提出位级混合权重存储，用 LUT 实现选定的权重位，将其余位存入 BRAM，并在推理时重建原始权重；2. 将该方案集成到空间数据流 SNN 架构，并提出在 BRAM 和基于 LUT 的逻辑之间高效分配权重位的启发式算法。

title: On the Design of a Slow Control Interlock System for the European GateMate FPGA
abstract: Slow Control Systems (SCSs) are essential for the monitoring, configuration, and protection of distributed safety-critical systems in scientific, industrial, and medical applications. Although software-based SCS architectures offer flexibility and scalability, they suffer from software aging and non-deterministic latencies, which limit long-term reliability and timely reaction to critical errors, often requiring additional hardware interlock systems. This paper presents an FPGA-centric lightweight Slow Control Interlock System (SCIS) designed to achieve deterministic ultra-low-latency reaction times in long-running dependable systems. System parameters are acquired and fused at runtime in a Supervisory Monitor Unit (SMU), enabling real-time fault condition classification and prioritization through configurable priority rules and triggering kill-switch actions with microsecond-scale latency. The proposed SMU has been described in VHDL as vendor-agnostic architecture, and assessed on the 28-nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA, using the open-source OSS-CAD-Suite toolchain. Experimental results show that the SMU architecture utilizes only 37,6% of LUTs, 9,4% of FFs, and 35,9% of BRAM. Furthermore, this low resource utilization allow to achieve 40,48 ms reconfiguration time, using OSS-CAD-Suite including gmpack v1.13. This is a key metric for rejuvenation and consequently for enabling aging mitigation in critical applications. Offloading the Ethernet stack to the W5500 Ethernet module and integrating the Grafana dashboard provides a lightweight, deterministic SCIS. This demonstrates the feasibility of our FPGA-centric architecture as a solution to the problem of combining ultra-low-latency interlock capabilities with the scalability of software-based systems.
abstract_cn: 慢控制系统（SCS）对于科研、工业和医疗应用中分布式安全关键系统的监测、配置和保护至关重要。基于软件的 SCS 架构具有灵活性和可扩展性，但软件老化和非确定性延迟会削弱长期可靠性，妨碍系统及时响应严重错误，因此往往需要额外配置硬件联锁系统。本文提出一种以 FPGA 为核心的轻量级慢控制联锁系统（SCIS），旨在让长期运行的可信赖系统具备确定性的超低延迟响应能力。监控单元（SMU）在运行时采集和融合系统参数，依据可配置的优先级规则实时识别故障类型、确定处理优先级，并以微秒级延迟触发紧急关断动作。所提出的 SMU 采用 VHDL 描述，架构独立于具体厂商，并使用开源 OSS-CAD-Suite 工具链在 28 nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA 上进行评估。实验结果表明，SMU 架构仅占用 37.6% 的查找表（LUT）、9.4% 的触发器（FF）和 35.9% 的块 RAM（BRAM）。此外，较低的资源占用使其在使用包含 gmpack v1.13 的 OSS-CAD-Suite 时达到 40.48 ms 的重配置时间。重配置时间是衡量系统复新的关键指标，因而对于在关键应用中缓解老化也很重要。通过将以太网协议栈卸载至 W5500 以太网模块并集成 Grafana 仪表板，系统实现了轻量化和确定性响应。这验证了以 FPGA 为核心的架构兼顾超低延迟联锁能力与软件系统可扩展性的可行性。
takeaway: 该 FPGA 联锁系统可在微秒级延迟内触发紧急关断。在 28 nm GateMate M1A1 上，SMU 占用 37.6% 的 LUT、9.4% 的 FF 和 35.9% 的 BRAM，使用包含 gmpack v1.13 的 OSS-CAD-Suite 时，重配置耗时 40.48 ms。
innovation: 1. 提出以 FPGA 为核心的轻量级慢控制联锁架构，并以 VHDL 实现厂商无关的 SMU，在运行时融合参数，依据可配置规则对故障实时分类和排序，并触发紧急关断；2. 将以太网协议栈卸载至 W5500 模块，并集成 Grafana 仪表板。

title: Mayfly: Lifecycle-Aware High-Bandwidth Flash for Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets an LLM improve its agent system by proposing and evaluating candidate variants across tasks. A generation's sessions grow their KV caches together and release them as they finish, creating a burst followed by a decline. At high concurrency, even the KV of sessions ready to run exceeds the GPU's HBM. Offloading that KV to host DRAM or SSDs adds capacity but leaves ready sessions waiting for HBM space before execution. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) can serve the overflow in place, but excessive reads lengthen decode steps and repeated writes consume flash endurance. Our key insight is that where ready KV is read should follow the burst and its decline: from HBF in place while the burst overflows HBM, as much as each step's bandwidth allows, and from HBM again as the decline frees it. A switch between ready and parked decides only whether a block is read, so its flash copy stays valid, and a session's end, which the orchestrator announces, decides when its private KV dies. We present Mayfly, lifecycle-guided HBF management for RSI. Mayfly bounds per-step HBF reads during overflow and returns KV to HBM as sessions finish and free space. It retains a valid backing copy of each block evicted from HBM to avoid rewrites across state transitions, and forwards session-end signals to the controller to avoid copying dead KV during garbage collection. Experimental results show that, at 128 sessions per generation on four added HBF sites, Mayfly finishes 34% sooner than parking the same KV on HBF and 23% sooner than reading it from HBF whenever HBM is full; its gain over parking grows with concurrency, to 55% at 256 sessions on eight sites. Keeping one flash copy per block and trimming at announced session ends avoid write amplification.
abstract_cn: 递归自我改进（RSI）让大语言模型（LLM）通过在多项任务上提出和评估候选变体来改进其智能体系统。同一代的各个会话同时扩充各自的 KV 缓存，并在各自结束时释放缓存，使总占用先快速上升，再逐步下降。在高并发下，仅就绪会话的 KV 缓存就会超出 GPU 的高带宽内存（HBM）容量。将这些 KV 缓存卸载到主机 DRAM 或 SSD 可以扩充容量，但就绪会话必须等到 HBM 腾出空间才能执行。高带宽闪存（HBF）可以就地提供溢出的 KV 缓存，但读取过多会延长解码步，反复写入也会消耗闪存的写入寿命。我们的核心思路是让就绪会话的 KV 读取位置随缓存占用的上升和回落而变化。峰值期间，只要占用超出 HBM 容量，就在每步带宽允许的范围内尽量从 HBF 就地读取。随着占用回落、HBM 腾出空间，再恢复从 HBM 读取。就绪和挂起状态之间的切换只决定是否读取某个块，因此该块的闪存副本仍然有效。会话何时结束由编排器通知，这一时刻决定其私有 KV 何时失效。本文提出 Mayfly，一种面向 RSI、依据会话生命周期管理 HBF 的方法。Mayfly 在溢出期间限制每步的 HBF 读取量，并随着会话结束、空间释放而将 KV 迁回 HBM。它为每个从 HBM 逐出的块保留有效的后备副本，以避免状态切换时重复写入，还将会话结束信号转发给控制器，以免垃圾回收时复制已失效的 KV。实验结果表明，在配置 4 个新增 HBF 站点且每代运行 128 个会话时，Mayfly 的完成耗时比将同一批 KV 缓存挂起存放于 HBF 的方案缩短 34%，比 HBM 一满就从 HBF 读取这些 KV 的方案缩短 23%。相对于挂起方案，Mayfly 的收益随并发度增大，在 8 个 HBF 站点运行 256 个会话时，完成耗时缩短 55%。每块仅保留一个闪存副本，并在收到会话结束通知时执行 TRIM，可避免写放大。
takeaway: 每代 128 个会话、配置 4 个新增 HBF 站点时，Mayfly 相比将同一批 KV 挂起存放于 HBF 的方案和 HBM 一满就从 HBF 读取的方案，完成耗时分别缩短 34% 和 23%。在 8 个站点运行 256 个会话时，相比挂起方案的耗时降幅扩大到 55%。
innovation: 1. 根据会话生命周期管理 KV 缓存，在 HBM 溢出期间限制每个解码步的 HBF 就地读取量，并随会话结束将 KV 迁回 HBM；2. 为每个从 HBM 逐出的块保留一个有效的闪存副本，避免状态切换时重复写入；3. 将会话结束信号转发给闪存控制器并执行 TRIM，避免垃圾回收复制已失效的 KV。

title: Beyond Autoregression: Diffusion Language Model is All Analog In-Memory Computing Need
abstract: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) enables energy-efficient language-model inference, but hardware non-idealities perturb matrix--vector multiplications and degrade generation quality. Autoregressive (AR) models are especially vulnerable: each token is committed to the causal context at birth, so perturbation-induced errors cascade. We study diffusion language models (DLMs), which iteratively refine a masked sequence, as an alternative paradigm. Across scale-matched model pairs and open checkpoints, DLMs degrade more gracefully than AR counterparts under persistent weight perturbations. Controlled analyses rule out cross-round noise averaging and support delayed token commitment and progressive context resolution as the mechanism. A larger denoising-step budget further shrinks the clean--noisy gap, a DLM-specific latency--robustness knob. We perform large-scale simulation tests across diverse datasets and models using a noise model calibrated from real silicon measurements. Furthermore, on a 16-chip 28nm eFlash AIMC cluster, hybrid on-board measurements show DLMs tolerate $1.4$--$3\times$ larger weight noise, making diffusion-based generation a promising paradigm for noise-resilient AIMC inference.
abstract_cn: 模拟存内计算（AIMC）可实现高能效的语言模型推理，但硬件非理想特性会扰动矩阵–向量乘法，降低生成质量。自回归（AR）模型尤其容易受到影响，因为每个词元一经生成就会被固定到因果上下文中，使扰动引入的错误逐步传播。本文研究扩散语言模型（DLM）作为另一种生成范式，这类模型通过迭代细化带掩码的序列来生成文本。基于规模匹配的模型对和公开检查点的评估表明，在持续权重扰动下，DLM 的性能退化比对应的 AR 模型更缓和。受控分析排除了跨轮次噪声平均这一解释，支持延迟确定词元和逐步明确上下文是其作用机制。增加去噪步数预算可以进一步缩小无噪声与有噪声条件下的性能差距，为 DLM 提供了特有的延迟与鲁棒性权衡手段。我们利用根据实际芯片测量数据校准的噪声模型，在多种数据集和模型上进行了大规模仿真测试。此外，在由 16 颗 28 nm 嵌入式闪存（eFlash）AIMC 芯片组成的集群上进行的混合式板上测量表明，DLM 可容忍幅度为 AR 模型 1.4–3 倍的权重噪声，显示出扩散生成在抗噪声 AIMC 推理中的潜力。
takeaway: 在规模匹配的对比中，持续权重扰动对 DLM 的影响比对 AR 模型更缓和，增加去噪步数可进一步缩小有噪声与无噪声条件下的性能差距。在 16 芯片 28 nm eFlash AIMC 集群上，混合式板上测量显示，DLM 可容忍幅度为 AR 模型 1.4–3 倍的权重噪声。
innovation: 1. 将通过多轮迭代细化掩码序列的 DLM 作为 AIMC 生成推理的替代范式，并通过受控分析检验延迟确定词元和逐步明确上下文的作用；2. 将去噪步数用于调节推理延迟与噪声鲁棒性的权衡；3. 采用实测芯片数据校准噪声模型，在多种数据集和模型上进行仿真，并在 16 芯片 AIMC 集群上进行混合式板上测量。

title: Walk the Cycle: An Efficient Stochastic Solver for Periodic Thermal Analysis of 2.5D/3D ICs
abstract: Long-term periodic thermal analysis is essential for designing 2.5D/3D ICs operating under periodic workloads. Deterministic global solvers can be costly for repeated thermal queries, while existing random-walk methods are not tailored to long-term periodic problems or multiscale 3D IC structures, limiting their efficiency and accuracy. We propose CycleWalker, a periodic residual random-walk solver. First, we formulate the periodic steady state (PSS) as an infinite-history backward walk, which needs no initial temperature or warm-up but charges the full temperature field to every path. Second, to cut this cost, we let the walk estimate only the residual of a periodic prior, and shorten long histories by Russian roulette while preserving unbiasedness. Third, since the estimator constrains the prior only to be periodic and piecewise linear in time, we build it at negligible cost by a coarse-grid Fourier solve followed by fine-grid smoothing. Finally, we construct a thermal graph aware of through-silicon vias (TSVs) that bounds the walk's jump rate while retaining the anisotropic conduction of TSV arrays. Experiments on periodic 2.5D/3D IC benchmarks show that, at equal accuracy, CycleWalker achieves up to 75.85X speedup over the transient random-walk solver.
abstract_cn: 长期周期性热分析对于设计在周期性负载下运行的 2.5D/3D 集成电路至关重要。反复求解热分析问题时，确定性全局求解器的开销可能较高，而现有随机游走方法对长期周期性问题或多尺度 3D 集成电路结构缺乏针对性，因而效率和精度受限。本文提出 CycleWalker，一种基于周期残差的随机游走求解器。首先，将周期稳态（PSS）表述为向无限历史回溯的随机游走。该表述无需指定初始温度或执行预热，但每条路径都要承担与完整温度场相关的计算开销。其次，为降低这一开销，随机游走仅估计周期先验解的残差，并通过俄罗斯轮盘法截短较长的历史路径，同时保持估计无偏。第三，由于估计器仅要求先验解具有周期性且随时间分段线性变化，因此可以先在粗网格上进行傅里叶求解，再在细网格上进行平滑，以可忽略的开销构造先验解。最后，构建考虑硅通孔（TSV）的热图模型，在限制游走跳转速率的同时保留 TSV 阵列的各向异性导热特性。在周期性 2.5D/3D 集成电路基准上的实验表明，在相同精度下，CycleWalker 相比瞬态随机游走求解器最高可实现 75.85 倍加速。
takeaway: 在周期性 2.5D/3D 集成电路基准上，CycleWalker 在相同精度下相比瞬态随机游走求解器最高加速 75.85 倍。
innovation: 1. 将周期稳态表述为向无限历史回溯的随机游走，省去初始温度和预热；2. 仅估计周期先验解的残差，并以俄罗斯轮盘法无偏截短长历史路径；3. 通过粗网格傅里叶求解和细网格平滑，以可忽略的开销构造时间上分段线性的周期先验解；4. 构建考虑 TSV 的热图模型，在限制跳转速率的同时保留 TSV 阵列的各向异性导热特性。

title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Hybrid Cooling of a Raspberry Pi 5
abstract: Thermal management is a critical challenge in compact computing platforms operating under sustained high computational loads. Elevated processor temperatures can lead to thermal throttling, degraded performance, and reduced reliability. This study develops and experimentally evaluates a smart hybrid heat sink that integrates passive thermal energy storage with active cooling for sustained device operation. The proposed design comprises an aluminum cavity containing paraffin wax as a phase change material (PCM) embedded within a copper foam and integrated with an adaptively controlled fan. Fan operation is guided by a Random Forest regression model trained on experimentally measured CPU temperature data to predict future CPU temperatures. The predicted temperature is then used to support the adaptive fan control strategy. The heat sink is mounted directly on the CPU of a Raspberry Pi 5 and experimentally evaluated under an extreme CPU workload of approximately 99 percent CPU utilization. The performance of the proposed hybrid system is compared against two benchmark scenarios: passive cooling using PCM embedded in copper foam and a commercial Raspberry Pi 5 active cooler. The proposed heat sink demonstrates superior thermal performance to both benchmarks, achieving peak CPU temperature reductions of approximately 9 C relative to the PCM-copper foam configuration and 6 C relative to the commercial active cooler.
abstract_cn: 对于在持续高计算负载下运行的紧凑型计算平台，热管理是一项关键挑战。处理器温度过高可能引发热降频，导致性能下降和可靠性降低。本研究开发并通过实验评估了一种智能混合式散热器，将被动蓄热与主动冷却结合，以支持设备持续运行。所提出的散热器由铝制腔体和自适应控制的风扇组成，腔体中装有泡沫铜，作为相变材料（PCM）的石蜡嵌入泡沫铜中。研究使用实验测得的 CPU 温度数据训练随机森林回归模型，以预测后续 CPU 温度，并将预测结果用于指导风扇的自适应控制。研究将散热器直接安装在 Raspberry Pi 5 的 CPU 上，在 CPU 利用率约为 99% 的极高负载下进行实验评估。混合散热系统与两种基准方案进行了比较，分别为采用嵌有 PCM 的泡沫铜进行被动冷却，以及使用市售 Raspberry Pi 5 主动散热器。所提出的散热器在热性能上优于两种基准方案，CPU 峰值温度较 PCM–泡沫铜方案降低约 9 °C，较市售主动散热器降低约 6 °C。
takeaway: 在 Raspberry Pi 5 的 CPU 利用率约为 99% 时，混合散热器使 CPU 峰值温度较 PCM–泡沫铜被动冷却方案降低约 9 °C，较市售 Raspberry Pi 5 主动散热器降低约 6 °C。
innovation: 1. 将铝腔内嵌有石蜡相变材料的泡沫铜与自适应风扇集成，结合被动蓄热与主动冷却；2. 利用实测 CPU 温度训练随机森林回归模型，以预测的后续温度指导风扇的自适应控制。
